text.tspan: Change in GDP per capita 1820 to 2022
GDP per capita is a country's gross domestic product divided by its population. This data is adjusted for inflation
and differences in living costs between countries.

tspan.tspan: Bolt and van Zanden – Maddison Project Database 2023
This data is expressed in international-$ at 2011 prices.
